build_gemma3n_model: build a Gemma3nModel with decoder frontend, decoder, final projection, and optional audio tower
run_forward_multimodal: run forward pass on Gemma3nModel with audio features and vision features for multimodal inference
run_forward_with_targets: run forward pass on Gemma3nModel with target tokens to compute cross-entropy loss
test_compute_fused_loss: test the compute_fused_loss method to compute cross-entropy loss from decoder output and targets
review_compile_loss: review the compile_loss method that applies torch.compile to the fused loss computation for optimization
